Excellent food but poor service
Feb 2017 • Friends
Two empty tables when we walked in. All tables have a charcoal (hibachi ?) grill inset for customers to grill their steak on (fun idea). We were seated at the rear of the restaurant and then suddenly changed to the other table at the front, no problem, only to be told that the table grill there "was broken". The waitress said she would be cooking our steaks in the back (kitchen). Then, without any warning, a waiter came over and took out the table grill, filled it with hot coals and all of a sudden it was working ?? He did not exchange it for another grill (confusing). We also waited a long time for our food to come out. I tried three times with hand signs to tell them I needed a fork and knife. So we were able to cook our excellent marinated steaks at our table. The prices are very low but I really should have ordered another steak, they are just not sufficient in size if you are hungry. Side dishes, miso soup, rice and dips were excellent. Recommend but expect inadequate service. No english spoken at all.
